title: docs(qa): re-point no-active-org-session-semantics audit clause to ADR-0131 D7/D9
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNXUbHBekZQ6WxHpNfGu7wV)_

Fixes #32111

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 只改测试清单一个条目 `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics`（r9 → r10）：审计条款 acceptance[4]/[6] 改为按 ADR-0131 D7/D9 判定（审计日志不归租户墙管，按对象权限读），去掉过时的 `blocked` 标记和两条已过期的 knownGaps。
- **为什么改:** QA 运行 #32102 在隔离/分组两种墙下实测：清空当前组织的成员登出，审计行 `tenant_id` 为空；平台管理员能读到（200），成员本人 403（对象权限）。旧条款要求「审计行不能没有租户、否则 RLS 读不到」，写于审计日志还在墙内时（#8245），D7 之后已不成立，所以判 FAIL 是规格过期，不是产品缺陷。
- **风险与回滚:** 纯文档（`docs/qa/**`），无产品代码、无 changeset（`skip-changeset`）。回滚 = revert。
- **先看:** acceptance[4] 新条款 + verify（谁必须能读、谁应被拒），以及 knownGaps[3] 新增的「生产者 (2)」段。
- **两分钟验证:** `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` exit 0；`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics --json` 不再需要 `--include-blocked`。
- **需要你做的:** 回答文末「Question for the maintainer」（清空当前组织的成员登出，审计行是否必须带组织归属？）。本 PR 不回答它，只把它带上来；席位审阅落地。

## What changes

One item in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`, `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics`, revision 9 → 10, with a `history` entry (ref #32111) citing QA run #32102 (subject `ff04ad81`, repro rule R-1). No other file: no `knownGaps[n]` cross-reference in this file, `RUNNER.md` or `FOLLOW-UPS.md` names the dropped lines (`git grep -n "knownGaps\[" -- docs/qa`; only this item's own `history` rows mention its `[4]`/`[5]`, and history is append-only).

### Re-points, before → after

| Where | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `acceptance[4].clause` | "the audit carve-out is paid for by ORDERING, not by an exemption: audit rows from a first session carry a real tenant — no audit row is NULL-tenanted and therefore permanently invisible to RLS readers (#8245)" | The ledger is read through object permission, not the wall (ADR-0131 D7): the session's login/logout rows exist in `sys_audit_log` (`systemFields: { tenant: false }`), whose `tenant_id` is an attribution field with its NULL arm kept by design (D7's 2026-10-22 note) and outside D9's no-NULL rule. The platform operator reads every such row, a NULL-attributed one included; the user is refused 403 by object permission. The attribution question is open (knownGaps[3]) and not scored. |
| `acceptance[4].verify` | "read … as a tenant-scoped reader; they must be visible. A row present in the raw table but invisible to every RLS reader is a FAIL" | As the operator, `GET /api/v1/data/sys_audit_log` filtered by user_id → 200 with every row, `tenant_id` quoted; a raw row the operator's read omits is a FAIL. As the user, the same read → 403 (a 5xx, or another user's rows, is a FAIL). A NULL `tenant_id` alone is not a FAIL: record it with its producer and knownGaps[3]. |
| `acceptance[4].evidence` | "raw rows + the RLS-scoped read of the same rows" | "raw rows with tenant_id + the operator's read of the same rows + the user's 403 envelope" |
| `acceptance[6]` clause + verify | three subsystems give the same answer; any disagreement is the finding | Unchanged, plus: under D7 the ledger's answer is acceptance[4]'s (written, read through object permission); a NULL `tenant_id` there is attribution, not a tenant column, so it is not a disagreement with the wall's refusal. A lost ledger row, or one the operator's read omits, still is. |
| `fixtures.knownGaps[3]` | open question for producer (1) only (a member-less user) | The same question for both producers. Producer (2), a member that cleared its active organization: #32102's rows (login A, login A, logout with `tenant_id` NULL, login A), operator 200, member 403, and the mechanism (`auth-session-audit.ts#logoutEventFor` takes the session's `activeOrganizationId`; `auth-event-audit.ts` writes `tenant_id` from the event, null when absent). It also says what a "must be attributed" answer would make of it. |
| `blocked` | `{ by: "fixture", ref: "#9334" }` | Dropped. #32102 booted the stock showcase walled from the tree (`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY`) on group and isolated and served every leg, which is RUNNER.md "A walled boot is a fixture of its own". Its run resolved the item with `--include-blocked` only because of this marker. |
| `fixtures.knownGaps[2]`, last sentence | "(no example app declares it) … The item stays blocked (fixture, #9334) because … the stock showcase provisions no walled boot" | "(examples/app-showcase declares it)" and: the walled boot runs from the tree, #32102 served every leg, so the item carries no blocked marker; a run that does not provision the walled boot records each walled leg blocked(fixture). |
| `fixtures.knownGaps[4]`, `[5]` | #24784 open: `group` producer (2) create → 500; acceptance[7] red until it lands, "when #24784's fix merges, re-run the clause and drop this line" | Dropped. #24784 closed (PR #24819) and #32102 measured it holding live on a walled group boot (acceptance[7] pass; the acceptance[1] 403, not the 500). `[0]`–`[3]` keep their indexes. |

## Why

QA run #32102 scored acceptance[4] and [6] FAIL. Under checklist-test §5 that is a stale spec: the product follows ADR-0131 D7 (`sys_audit_log` is "governed by object permission, not by the wall"; its `tenant_id` "is not a tenant column", NULL arm kept by design), and the clause pins the shape from #8245, when the ledger was walled. D9 scopes the no-NULL rule to tenant-column objects ("column ⇒ in scope"). Rule 7 of the run had a second agent re-derive the verdict from the evidence; it agreed. The other four edits are the run's own checklist-accuracy note A-1 and the re-runs that knownGaps[4]/[5] asked for.

## Question for the maintainer

Should a logout by an organization member who cleared its active organization carry organization attribution?

- **If yes ("must be attributed"):** this becomes a product defect in plugin-auth `auth-session-audit.ts` `logoutEventFor`, which takes the session's `activeOrganizationId` (null in this state). knownGaps[3] says so, and acceptance[4] would then gain the attribution as a scored fact.
- **If no:** knownGaps[3]'s question closes for producer (2) and acceptance[4] stands as re-pointed here.

The same question has been open for producer (1), a member-less user, since QA run #24783 (finding F3). This PR answers neither. It carries both in `fixtures.knownGaps[3]`, and it changes no product code (`plugin-auth/**` and `plugin-audit/**` untouched).

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` → exit 0 (16 areas, 361 items; symbol anchors resolve, including `auth-session-audit.ts#logoutEventFor`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 16 families derived; each run, each exit 0 (`check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3, since it reads built output, then exit 0 after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`). `dispatch-gates --ran` → 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- No live run is owed: the run record #32102 is the evidence.

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (n/a)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 section is in Chinese, as the seat's order asks)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
